text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a gain and later buying it back at a higher price reminds me not to sell just to lock in a satisfying profit; I should act only when its future risk and return warrant it.","My account rose and fell while I mostly held, and those swings did not reliably signal what came next; I should not treat recent price moves as forecasts.","Before each review, I should check whether my allocation still fits my goals and risk tolerance, then make deliberate, diversified decisions rather than trade from regret or avoid decisions simply because I check infrequently."]}
